_readme: Chapter-6 inference COMMON knobs. Task-specific bits (model_name,
in tasks.json next to this file, grouped by quadrant. The entry-point
notebook / runner picks which task to load via a TASK constant or
--task flag; add a task by appending an entry under its quadrant in
Layering (later wins): Config defaults -> shared -> tasks.json
quadrant/task entry -> modes[run_mode]. Unknown keys are a hard error.
Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are stripped before layering.
